mentions.name: Relic AI
mentions.description: Relic AI is a save-and-recall tool with a browser extension for saving the current page, PDF tabs, all open tabs, bookmarks, and YouTube videos including playlists. Each save gets an automatic summary and tags, and a Q&A interface answers questions using only the saved content, citing numbered sources and saying so when nothing relevant is saved. It is free during the beta, with new features shipped based on user feedback.
mentions.problem: Saved resources like articles, YouTube lectures, and podcasts (and tabs left open as reminders) were hard to find when actually needed, so people often ended up redoing the research from scratch.
mentions.audience: The builders' own saving workflow: keeping articles, YouTube lectures, podcasts, and open tabs as reminders and finding them later.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Relic AI: https://app.relic-app.com

Three of us in Sarajevo are building it.

It started because we kept saving things such as articles, Youtube lectures and podcasts, leaving open tabs as reminders for things to come back to later, but couldn't find those resources when we actually needed them, most of the time ending up redoing the research over again.

We have a browser extension for easy saving. It currently supports the page you're on, a PDF tab, all your open tabs, your bookmarks, and Youtube videos (including playlists). Each save gets a summary and tags. Then you can ask it questions, and it answers only from what you saved, with numbered sources. If nothing relevant is saved about what you are asking, it says so.
